If sentiment is >0.67 in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 0.5–1.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is <0.33 in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 0.5–1.5% for mid horizon (8–15 days) to counteract pessimism.  
If sentiment is 0.33–0.67 and forecast is trending up, reduce forecast by 1–2% in late horizon (16–30 days) to prevent overshoot.  
If sentiment is 0.00–0.33 and forecast is trending down, increase forecast by 1–2% in late horizon to offset downward bias.  
If sentiment spikes to 1.00 within 3 days, reduce forecast by 1–2% for the next 5 days to reflect market overreaction.  
If sentiment drops to 0.00 within 3 days, increase forecast by 1–2% for the next 5 days to reflect market underreaction.
